votes.motion: Commissioner Van Hoff motioned to approve the minutes for the December 16, 2021 Planning Commission Meeting

Commissioner Squire motioned to approve Home Occupation Conditional Use Permit as requested by Debi Babinski, representing MD Aesthetics LLC for a personal care service business, Application USE-0180-2021, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report, dated January 19, 2022

Commissioner Fowler motioned to forward a positive recommendation to the city council for the Airborne-Alcatraz zoning map request, as requested by Stew Knight of KREA, Application TEXTMAP-200-2021, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report, dated February 1, 2022

Commissioner Hawker motioned to forward a positive recommendation to the City Council to the amendment to the Planning Commission bylaws, rules and procedures as proposed by staff, based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the agenda memo for this agenda item to also include a change that the abstention section be put back in
Commissioner Fowler made a motion to adjourn the meeting. All were in favor. The meeting adjourned at 8:50p.m. 8
